title: 第1章 香火
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 重要说明：1.成长型女主，由弱到强，有事业线，最后发家致富。全是细糠，越往后越精彩。2.乡村瓜，离奇又离谱，大黄丫头开黄瓜，无三观，一言不合就放瓜。3.你没见过的瓜，不敢想的瓜，这里给你刷刷新。4.部分人物有原型，感情线细腻，有默默守护，有爱而不得，想吃细糠信我不会错。5.瓜大又多，个个保熟，入手记得马上加书架。6.重要的事说三遍，加书架，加书架，加书架。懂的都懂。……徐喜弟软乎乎躺在床上，看着破帐前的一对红烛。没多久，婆婆范金花走进来，往床沿一坐。“喜弟啊，你也十八了，我十八生的巴儿姐。”“可这个家你也知道，现在就全指望你，能给张家留个后。”留个后？生孩子？徐喜弟脑子嗡的一声，她虽然身子软绵绵的，但脑子很清醒。刚刚那碗甜酒蛋有问题！范金花把声调压了压，凑到她的耳边，嘻索道，“我已经安排好了，等下吹灯后，你只管闭上眼，张开腿，别的什么都不要问。”“我找人算好了日子，肯定可以一举得男。今天也是赶了大巧，要是能给张家生个聪明儿子，你就是大功臣，张家会一辈子记你的好。”“你放心，只要怀了孩子，家里家外，咱们只认是阿福的娃，外边不会有人知道。”什么？这是要她跟谁生孩子？徐喜弟忍不住打一个哆嗦，心里直犯怵，会是张国海吗？如果是他，那她宁愿以死了之。张国海五十了，身形佝偻，一边肩甲耸得高高的，贴着耳根。从她记事起，他走路都是弯腰弓背的。她为了还恩，可以给他们全家人养老、送终，绝不包括给张国海这样的老头生孩子。范金花说完站起身，“这灯，我就帮你吹了，别浪费。”吹灭红烛，屋里就陷入了黑暗，范金花拉开房门走了出去。黑暗里，徐喜弟咬着牙，伸手摸到枕头下，找那把剪刀。还是戳脖子算了！从她十二岁开始，枕头下就开始放一把剪子，防的就是今天这样的事。门外低声嘻嘻索索说了什么之后，木门被轻轻推开了。被子里的徐喜弟身体一僵，手在枕头下也摸了个空。怎么回事？！早上还在的，这会儿怎么就不见了？范金花什么时候偷偷拿走的？徐喜弟很着急。没有剪刀，怎么办？正想着，一道模糊的身影已经摸到了床前。对方似乎很适应这样的黑暗，自顾坐在床沿脱鞋子，然后掀开被子躺了进来。下一刻，一双强有力的大手就把她按住。嘤~完了！她低声惊呼，很快就被重重压住。挣扎中，她触到了对方坚实的臂膀。不是张国海！那会是谁？徐喜弟是童养媳，‘丈夫’张永福有天生小儿麻痹症，不能行房生育。从她懂事开始，每天都在盼着张永福死。只要张永福死了，她就能解脱。谁知张家却突然来这么一出，要借种来延续香火。把她当牲口用？难怪公婆这两个月，总背着她叽叽咕咕的。这是欺负她软弱，没有娘家人撑腰。因为没处可去，即便受了委屈也得忍着。她现在全身软乎乎的，连拳头都捏不起来，要怎么办？一行泪顺着她的眼角往下流。恨。她恨那对生了她，不到一岁又丢在寒冬里的父母。所有人都说张家连饭都吃不饱，还把她捡回来养大，是救命之恩。可实际呢，是把她捡回来给张永福做媳妇的啊！徐喜弟抽噎起来，泪水哗哗往下淌。上天为何如此待她？身上的人知道她在哭，停顿了许久，似乎内心也在挣扎。他用粗糙的大手，轻轻地给她擦泪，动作很温柔。但越擦越多，他干脆翻躺到一边，把她紧紧拥进怀里。等到她哭累了，他才低头亲吻她的额头，眼角，脸颊……还有唇。最后喘着粗气，把头埋进她颈窝，毫无章法地一阵乱拱。酥酥麻麻的，还有点痒。把她拱得整个人逐渐飘忽起来。但她只能软软地任他施为。时间似乎过得特别漫长，床板咿咿呀呀摇到了深夜，最后他突然就翻身下床，提起裤子就走。徐喜弟终于在黑暗中睁开眼，此时她依旧是烂泥坨，还不能动弹。……日上三竿，她还是头一回起不来床。身子酸痛得跟扛了两百斤的玉米一样。范金花推门进来，脸色不怎么好看，“太阳晒屁股了还不起床？永福拉裤子了，你赶紧去清理，给他洗洗。”说着，范金花一把就掀开徐喜弟的被子，看到她身上遍布的红痕，脸色变得更加复杂起来。徐喜弟也不给范金花好脸色，什么话都没说，坐起身，拿起床尾的衣服，一件件穿上，然后缓缓下床，掰着腿别扭地出了房门。范金花瞟了一眼床单上的那抹殷红，心情复杂地重重呼了一口气，然后翻个白眼，跟着出了房间。……徐喜弟从十二岁就开始照顾张永福的屎尿。公婆这么对她，还想让她跟从前一样，无微不至伺候张永福吃喝拉撒？行啊！徐喜弟熟练地把那只瘦猴夹在腋下，从屋里带到后院。一脚把板凳往身前一勾，坐下后，把张永福翻了个身，让他趴在自己腿上，然后利落地扒掉裤子。撇着一口气，舀了一瓢冷水，就往他邋遢的屁股上一泼，第二瓢，第三瓢……“嘶！冷！徐喜弟你想冷死我吗？”张永福暴躁地大声嚷嚷。“冷？忍着吧！”徐喜弟刚经历了昨夜的憋屈，对张永福再没了从前的好脾气。“你个贱人，敢虐待我！”张永福有些气急败坏。后院就只有他们两个人，徐喜弟也不客气了，“要么你忍着，要么你自己来！”张永福转过头，狠狠盯着徐喜弟。昨夜他就睡在隔壁屋，听她呻吟到大半夜。忽然他心一横，伸手就摸向徐喜弟的衣摆，快速往里探。不具备一个做男人的身体，但他有一颗原始且火热的心！徐喜弟冷不丁被抓了一下，惊得直接站起来，腿上的瘦猴被抖落在地，屁股还没冲干净，又在地上滚了两圈。一阵懵逼后，张永福扯开嗓子就大声尖叫。“妈！爸！你们快来！”
content_en: Important notes: 1. A growth-oriented heroine who grows from weak to strong, has a career line, and finally becomes rich.It’s all fine chaff, and the further you go, the more exciting it gets.2. Cucumbers in the countryside are bizarre and outrageous. The big yellow girl opens cucumbers without any three senses.3. The melons you have never seen before, the melons you dare not think about, are refreshed here for you.4. Some characters have prototypes, delicate emotional lines, silent protection, and love that cannot be found. If you want to eat fine chaff, believe me, I will not be wrong.5. The melons are big and plentiful, and they all stay cooked. Remember to add a bookshelf as soon as you get them.6. Say important things three times, add bookshelf, add bookshelf, add bookshelf.Everyone who understands understands....Xu Xidi lay limply on the bed, looking at the pair of red candles in front of the broken curtain.Not long after, mother-in-law Fan Jinhua walked in and sat on the edge of the bed."Brother Xi, you are also eighteen, my eighteenth-year-old sister Ba'er." "But you also know this family, and now they are counting on you to give the Zhang family a heir." A heir?Have a baby?Xu Xidi's head buzzed. Although her body was limp, her mind was very clear.There was something wrong with that bowl of rummy eggs just now!Fan Jinhua lowered her voice, leaned close to her ear, and said jokingly, "I have already arranged it. After the lamp is turned off, you just close your eyes, open your legs, and don't ask anything else." "I have calculated the days with someone, and I will definitely get a man in one fell swoop. Today.It's a coincidence. If you can give birth to a smart son for the Zhang family, you will be a great hero, and the Zhang family will remember you forever.""Don't worry, as long as you are pregnant with the child, we will only recognize it as Ah Fu's baby, and no one outside will know."Who is she going to have a baby with?Xu Xidi couldn't help but shiver, and was frightened. Could it be Zhang Guohai?If it were him, she would rather die.Zhang Guohai is fifty years old, with a stooped figure, and one shoulder armor is raised high, close to the base of his ear.For as long as she could remember, he had walked with a stooped back.In order to repay her kindness, she could provide for their whole family in their old age, which would not include giving birth to children for an old man like Zhang Guohai.After Fan Jinhua finished speaking, he stood up and said, "I will blow out this lamp for you. Don't waste it." After blowing out the red candle, the room fell into darkness. Fan Jinhua opened the door and walked out.In the darkness, Xu Xidi gritted his teeth and reached under the pillow, looking for the scissors.Just stick it in the neck!Ever since she was twelve years old, she had been keeping a pair of scissors under her pillow just in case something like this happened today.After someone whispered something outside the door, the wooden door was gently pushed open.Xu Xidi's body stiffened under the quilt, and his hands were empty under the pillow.What's going on?!It was there in the morning, why is it gone now?When did Fan Jinhua secretly take it away?Xu Xidi was very anxious.What should I do if I don’t have scissors?Just as he was thinking about it, a vague figure had already touched the bed.The other party seemed to be very used to the darkness. He sat on the edge of the bed and took off his shoes, then lifted the quilt and lay down.The next moment, a pair of strong hands held her down.Oh~ It’s over!She exclaimed in a low voice and was soon suppressed heavily.During the struggle, she touched the other party's solid arm.Not Zhang Guohai!Who could that be?Xu Xidi was a child bride, and her husband Zhang Yongfu was born with polio and was unable to have sex.Ever since she was sensible, she has been looking forward to Zhang Yongfu's death every day.As long as Zhang Yongfu dies, she will be free.Who would have thought that the Zhang family would suddenly come here and want to borrow seeds to continue their incense.Use her as an animal?No wonder her parents-in-law have been chirping behind her back for the past two months.This is bullying her for being weak and having no support from her maternal family.Because I have nowhere to go, I have to endure it even if I feel wronged.Her whole body is so soft now that she can't even make a fist. What should she do?A line of tears flowed down from the corner of her eyes.hatred.She hated the parents who gave birth to her and left her in the cold winter when she was less than a year old.Everyone said that the Zhang family didn't even have enough to eat, so they picked her up and raised her, which was a life-saving grace.But in reality, she was picked up to be Zhang Yongfu’s wife!Xu Xidi started to sob, tears streaming down his face.Why did God treat her like this?The person on her body knew that she was crying. She paused for a long time and seemed to be struggling internally.He gently wiped her tears with his big, rough hands, his movements gentle.But the more he rubbed her, the more he rubbed her. He simply rolled over to the side and held her tightly in his arms.When she was tired of crying, he lowered his head and kissed her forehead, corners of her eyes, cheeks...and lips.Finally, he gasped for breath, buried his head in the crook of her neck, and humped randomly.It feels numb and a little itchy.He arched her until her whole body gradually became erratic.But she could only let him do whatever he wanted.The time seemed to pass extremely long, and the bed board made noises late into the night. Finally, he suddenly got out of bed, picked up his pants, and left.Xu Xidi finally opened her eyes in the darkness. At this time, she was still a lump of mud and could not move.... It was three o'clock in the morning, but she still couldn't get out of bed for the first time.My body ached as if I had carried two hundred kilograms of corn.Fan Jinhua pushed the door open and came in with a sullen face, "Why don't you get up when the sun is shining on your butt? Yongfu has pooped his pants. Go and clean him up quickly." With that said, Fan Jinhua lifted Xu Xidi's quilt and her face became more complicated when she saw the red marks all over her body.Xu Xidi didn't give Fan Jinhua a good look. Without saying anything, he sat up, picked up the clothes at the end of the bed, put them on one by one, then slowly got out of bed, crossed his legs and awkwardly walked out of the room.Fan Jinhua glanced at the bright red color on the sheets, took a deep breath with complicated emotions, rolled her eyes, and left the room....Xu Xidi has been taking care of Zhang Yongfu's urine since he was twelve years old.After her parents-in-law treated her like this, they still wanted her to serve Zhang Yongfu with every possible care like before?OK!Xu Xidi skillfully held the skinny monkey under his arm and took it from the house to the backyard.He pushed the bench forward with his foot. After sitting down, he turned Zhang Yongfu over, letting him lie on his lap, and then took off his pants neatly.With a sigh of relief, he scooped up a ladle of cold water and poured it on his sloppy butt. The second ladle, the third ladle... "His! Cold! Xu Xidi, do you want to freeze me to death?" Zhang Yongfu shouted irritably."Cold? Bear with it!" Xu Xidi had just experienced the frustration of last night, and he no longer had the good temper towards Zhang Yongfu."You bitch, how dare you abuse me!" Zhang Yongfu was a little angry.There were only two of them in the backyard, and Xu Xidi was not polite, "Either you endure it, or you do it yourself!" Zhang Yongfu turned his head and stared at Xu Xidi fiercely.He slept in the next room last night and listened to her moaning until midnight.Suddenly his heart skipped a beat, and he stretched out his hand to touch the hem of Xu Xidi's clothes and quickly dug inside.He doesn't have the body to be a man, but he has a raw and fiery heart!Xu Xidi was suddenly caught, and he stood up in shock. The skinny monkey on his legs was shaken to the ground. Before his butt was cleaned, it rolled twice on the ground.After being stunned for a while, Zhang Yongfu screamed at the top of his lungs."Mom! Dad! Come quickly!"
